This document outlines the maintenance procedures 
P1, 
which should be carried out every three years as indicated by Y3 in the title 
block.

The technical specification of the hydro unit: 
Francis Turbine max. power 180MW, max head 75m, speed 100 RPM, Woodward 
governor.

The first draft 
was initiated by eng. Mohamed Abd Allah Ismaiel, tested by eng. Atef Sadeq 
Sayed, accepted by eng. Ahmed Saber Gabr: general director, approved by eng. 
Abdel-Karem Abuaid: head sector of High Dam power station, and 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control general 
director & MPIS coordinator.

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.

Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.

سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل 
 is required.

ارتداء الخاص بك 
 معدات السلامة والصحة مثل خوذة السلامة، أحذية السلامة، قناع التنفس، 
 زجاج الأمان...إلخ

Water level 
 at draft tube not exceed 100m.

Secure 
 closing intake and draft tubes maintenance gates.

Close the 
 main oil valve no.7.

Release 
 pressure of the oil pressure unit MHY to zero.

Disassemble
ال pack casing, bush و 
rubber ring

Inspect the 
state of the rubber ring and working surface of stainless made bush, to make the 
formular no. 5 of the gaps between the shaft and steel ring, if it is necessary, 
to replace the rubber ring

Flush the 
pipelines of water supply to shaft working pack. The water must be supplied 
through the big ring - shaped collector and through the reserve line to shaft 
working pack from the fire main. The pressure on the collector must be 5 atm. To 
clean the drainage pipe

Cover the shaft 
zone of working pack and steel ring with the anticorrosion compound
